data.name: ZEROAD
data.detailed_description:
A mix of intense shooter, roguelite, and RPG. Strength is forged on asphalt, and experience is the only resource you can't lose. Clear roads, kill zombies, earn XP, and level up your survivor, who grows stronger with every run. Find weapons, increase their rarity, and modify them with random affixes to craft a devastating combo for your next push.

Choose Your Road

After each road, you choose the next one, one of three. You decide what lies ahead. What matters more: testing your luck in search of a new weapon, upgrading your current one, or pushing forward fast? And with 40 types of zombies, each with unique traits and behaviors, there's no room to relax.

Find and Upgrade Weapons

Discover new weapons in cabinets at the end of certain roads. Each cabinet offers three firearms to choose from, a familiar way to refresh your loadout. A weapon's rarity determines its stats and the number of affix slots. Affixes are random modifiers that directly boost the weapon or enhance your character's attributes. Higher-level roads offer more powerful guns, with higher rarity and stronger affixes. In total, you can find over 60 firearms and 30 different affixes on the road, making every combination unique and memorable.

Lose Your Gear, Keep Your Experience

Death on the road strips you of all resources and equipment, but leaves all accumulated experience intact. Every surge of adrenaline and every slain zombie turns into XP that stays with your survivor forever. Invest it in your character's stats, these can never be taken away. Each new run starts with a weak weapon, but a stronger, more experienced roader.

Solo and Co-op Runs

Face the road alone, where the price of a mistake is ultimate. Or bring a partner, two-player co-op offers a chance for salvation. Coordinate your actions, watch each other's backs, and plan your route together. The road will test if you can act in unison under the relentless pressure of the horde.

The road is calling. See you on the asphalt.

data.short_description: ZEROAD is a fast-paced roguelite shooter. Fight your way through diverse roads and zombie hordes, growing stronger each run. Loot uniquely modified weapons, level up your character, and push further every time – play solo or in two-player co-op!

content_descriptors.notes: The content can be considered mature because the game's core mechanics revolve around killing enemies with guns. The art style is unrealistic, and the gore is stylized and unrealistic.
